messages:
ashwin (eng-runtime): FYI: noticed p99 token latency for customer ORION on /v1/generate jumped ~2.8x starting 02:40 UTC. Median looks fine.
lenora (observability): Any deploys or infra work around then? can you paste the token-level breakdown + kernel counts? :thinking_face: 
sahil (eng-runtime): No deploys. Quick trace snippets: 
```
token_latency.total.p99: 90ms -> 255ms
token_latency.kernel_exec.p99: 24ms -> 85ms
token_latency.decode.p99: 8ms -> 12ms
kv_cache.lookup.p99: 1.2ms -> 1.5ms
batching.wait.p95: 2ms
```
Also kernel_choice summary from tracing collector: optimized: 72%, fallback: 28% on the impacted hosts.
ashwin (eng-runtime): That smells like kernel fallback on older GPUs after the driver patch. I also checked the cache: ORIONs sessions are spread across many workers after the shard change, kv evictions jumped ~4x for that org.
jia (eng-platform): Which host pool and GPU types? we need to know scope (host vs org) and RBAC implications for dashboards.
sahil (eng-runtime): Affected hosts are pool-az3-v100-*. A100 hosts show optimized kernels. The V100 hosts had a CUDA patch applied around 01:50 UTC.
lenora (observability): Dashboards show per-route KPIs: only /v1/generate impacted and in the org-scoped view ORIONs tail is visible. Other tenants on same host not as bad because their sessions are more sticky to fewer workers.
ashwin (eng-runtime): Looks like two orthogonal issues converged: (1) kernel selection fallback on patched V100s, (2) KV cache fragmentation after last-months multi-tenant partitioning change (more shards + hash routing).
sahil (eng-runtime): Proposal for metrics exposure: 
- kernel_choice.{host,gpu_type,outcome} => counters
- token_latency.{kernel_exec,decode,kv_lookup} per_route per_org rollups
- kv_cache.{hits,misses,evictions,partition_size} with optional org label (enterprise only)
jia (eng-platform): RBAC note: org labels must only be returned to Console users who belong to that org or have platform/admin perms. avoid leaking org-level telemetry. Also avoid metric-cardinality explosion.
lenora (observability): Implementation plan: 
1) instrument kernel selection on the hot path; emit kernel_choice counters with low-cardinality labels (gpu_type, outcome).
2) annotate KV entries with org_id and emit 1m rollups: kv_cache.partition_size{org_id} and kv_cache.evictions{org_id} for enterprise orgs. sample/aggregate others.
3) dashboards: per-host kernel panel, per-org kv panel (enterprise dropdown), per-route token-latency breakdown with org filter.
4) alerts: page when kernel_choice.fallback{gpu=~"v100"} > 10% for 5m AND kv_cache.evictions{org=ORION} > 50/min.
ashwin (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigations: pin ORION traffic to A100 reserved pool and enable model-variant fallback to quantized variant to avoid the fp32 kernel path. Also consider rolling back the cuda patch on a subset of V100s until root cause is confirmed.
sahil (eng-runtime): Telemetry PR notes: keep kernel_choice labels minimal (gpu_type, outcome); avoid adding model_variant label in high-volume metrics. For org metrics, sample non-enterprise orgs into 'other_orgs' rollup.
ops-bot: infra: rolled back cuda patch on pool-az3-v100-01 at 03:10 UTC for testing.
jia (eng-platform): Console RBAC checklist: metric query filters by org membership, UI dropdown shows only enterprise orgs, log audit event when org-scoped queries executed.
lenora (observability): I'll add temporary Grafana tiles for kernel_choice and org kv metrics (enterprise-only). will post link to #eng-runtime-dashboards when ready.
ashwin (eng-runtime): I'll draft the internal incident note + customer-facing summary for CS. Assigning: @sahil kernel telemetry PR, @lenora dashboards + alerts, @jia RBAC + audit.
sahil (eng-runtime): Starting PR now. Will include unit tests for metrics labels and a stress run to verify no cardinality surge.
lenora (observability): ack. created cards: ENGRT-4221 (telemetry), OBS-128 (dashboards), PLAT-986 (rbac filters).
ashwin (eng-runtime): Keeping this thread as the source of truth for updates. If anyone sees new p99 spikes after mitigations, paste kernel_choice counts + kv_cache.evictions{org=ORION}.
